svg.title: High hemoglobin sorted by serum EPO: low EPO is primary (polycythemia vera, confirmed by JAK2 or marrow) and normal or high EPO is secondary (systemic hypoxia, renal hypoxia or an EPO-secreting tumour, and drugs), with clues, tests and treatment for each
